svg.title: RMR control panel terminal block colors
svg.text: RMR control panel: terminal block colors
Sheet 2E: the color of every terminal block, read from the wire lists that draw sheets 2A and 2B, so it follows the terminal plan. Each rail at 1:1 along its length, front of the box at the left.
A block takes the color of the wire that lands on it
110 VAC neutral (the kits have no white), signals and spares
+24 V, always on and behind K2
every 0 V: 0V-P, 0V-S and the supplies' own (blue wire, white bands)
+6 V servo supply: its wire is red, the block says it is not 24 V
PE: grounding blocks, which bond to their rail
Never use the kits' plain green blocks: they look like PE and do not
bond to the rail. What lands on each terminal: sheet 2C.
USLKG 5 or the kits' grounding blocks, 9 of them one per other DIN rail
The two kits hold 120 blocks in six colors; the listing does not give the split (20 of
each if even). Count them first. If blue runs short, make the 0V-S2 bus grey with a
0V marker; if grey then runs short, leave X8's spares off the rail until they are needed.
The per-rail blocks are not placed on sheets 2A, 2B and 3 yet (ADR-0014).
0 V of the servo and Pi supplies
RMR control panel: terminal block colors
Sheet 2E (2A, 2B: the decks; 2C: terminals). Legal 14 x 8.5 in, 100 %.
Colors from the wire lists of sheets 2A and 2B.
